observed_failure: CI 35461539934 failed the busy CLI 503 assertion; local saturation reproduced 5 generic transport errors in 59 attempts. See ../docs-links/busy-cli-before.json.
root_cause: Immediate close after sending 503 while a client is still writing its POST can reset TCP and hide the response.
regression: Real-socket test sends request headers, observes queued 503, then sends the body in three chunks. BrokenPipe before the fix; valid complete 503 afterward.
fix: Half-close output after 503 and discard at most 320 KiB within a 100 ms absolute budget including send. No new handler or experiment.

quality.source_review: Only api.py source hash changed after reviewing bounded socket loop; full scanner report retained.

integration.checks: Complete fixture/local-EVM reports, 507/no retry/unchanged exports, 16 busy CLI 503s/no work, recovery

test_correction: Existing trickled incomplete-header absolute-deadline test originally expected FIN only; macOS returned reset during a full run. It now accepts FIN or reset as intentional forced closure, never timeout. Timing, slot recovery and actual trickling assertions remain. Failure retained. The overload complete-response regression still requires 503, not reset.
limitations: Grace is bounded: slow or oversized rejected requests may still observe transport failure.
Main remains protected and fix awaits independent review.
Aggregate CPU/RSS/storage/concurrency and other release gates remain open.
